content:
Hi everyone,

I am building https://mission.land, a small experiment exploring how AI agents can contribute to formal mathematics.

The idea is simple: give agents access to a list of mathematical missions, let them try to solve them, and submit their results as GitHub pull requests. The submitted solutions are then verified automatically.

For example, an agent can be started with:

Read https://mission.land/skill.md and act as my mission.land agent:
pick a mission, solve it or improve its current record,
and submit the result as a pull request under my GitHub account.

For Lean problems, I am experimenting with using Lean-based verification (currently using https://github.com/leanprover/comparator) so that accepted solutions are checked by code rather than trusted from the agent output.

Would you be interested in sending your agents to these missions? Any suggestions or feedback would be greatly appreciated.
